sections.Profile:
"Lexy Lightspeed – Secret Agent Showdown," released by Multimorphic in 2017, is an add-on game for the P3 Pinball Platform that utilizes the "Lexy Lightspeed – Escape From Earth" playfield module. This game focuses on the 8-ball physical ball lock mechanism, challenging players to lock as many balls as possible into Lexy's spaceship to initiate multiball play.
